headline: Clean 0-1' at Lowtide — Time to Order Those New Boards
text: Monday lowtide check and it's another small one, folks — sitting 0-1' with just enough to keep the shorebreak honest. The saving grace is that light 5 mph SSW wind keeping everything very clean and glassy. It's warm and humid already with storms in the forecast for later, so get your beach time in early. Not much for the surfers this morning, but this is the time of year to play the long game: hit the gym, get your paddling fitness dialed, and order those new boards now — because the peak of hurricane season runs late August into mid-September, and you want to be ready when the Atlantic finally turns on. Athena's leading the way down the dune path to check it herself. Enjoy the Monday and stay dry when the storms roll through!

headline: 1' and glassy — light SW offshore grooming the occasional longboard nugget at mid-low outgoing
text: 7 AM check at Picnic Tables, South Cocoa Beach. It's small — call it a foot with an occasional set that'll let the log run a little. But the light SW is blowing offshore and feathering those nearshore peelers into clean, glassy little walls, so what's out there is worth a few cruisey turns if you're on the right board. Mid-to-low tide, outgoing. Athena worked the beach this morning past the turtle nest markers — nesting season's in full swing, so mind the roped-off crawls. Surf fisherman set up down the line and the fish are biting, so the longboarders and the anglers can share the lineup in peace. Summer doldrums special: dust off the log, lower your expectations, and have fun out there.

headline: Glassy 1' Nearshore — Bring a Pole, Not a Board
text: Incoming low tide at 8:45 with a clean 1-footer breaking right on the sand. Deep blue water, clear skies, and barely a ripple of texture — pretty as a postcard but no real push for surfers. The real action is in the water: a huge school of fish moving through just off the beach, with birds working overhead and a couple folks already out. Leave the board, grab the poles — that's a bite-window setup if I've ever seen one. Athena approved the patrol. Pray for a storm and book your plane tickets if you're after waves; this stretch is a fishing morning.
